# White Black Box (WBB.)

> WBB. White Black Box is a software development studio based in Coimbatore,
> Tamil Nadu, India. We build websites, AI-powered apps, micro-SaaS products,
> and white-label software for founders and businesses worldwide.

## What We Do

White Black Box offers two delivery models:
- **White Side**: Products built and launched publicly under the WBB. brand.
- **Black Side**: Fully white-label builds — no WBB branding, full IP transfer
  to the client. Ideal for agencies and founders who want a silent tech partner.

## Services

- **Website Development** — Fast, responsive, conversion-driven websites built
  with modern stacks.
- **Mobile & AI Apps** — Cross-platform mobile apps with AI integration, built
  to scale.
- **Landing Pages** — High-converting pages delivered in 5–7 days.
- **Micro-SaaS Development** — Focused software products from idea to launch.
- **Custom Software** — Internal tools, automations, dashboards, and APIs.
- **White-label Software** — Full invisible builds for agencies and resellers.

## Who We Serve

Startup founders, solo entrepreneurs, product managers, personal brands,
and global businesses. Clients across India, the UK, the US, and the EU.

## Why Choose WBB.

- India-based studio with global delivery — quality without the agency price tag
- AI-integrated by default in every product
- Founder-led: you talk directly to the people building your product
- White-label ready with full IP rights and zero trace of WBB.
- 100% on-time delivery with milestone-based transparency
